# Multiplayer protocol v2

Catalog SHA-256: `84bbcaa2b3d1a72ab82c1ef7d63bc752ee8c7e3fc9b13f086b33aeb0d4dabb02`. Catalog identity hashes the canonical schema catalog inputs, excluding display-only changelog.

One binary WebSocket message = one frame. No XOR, Worker RPC or native struct layout. Integers/floats are little-endian; floats must be finite. Envelope: ASCII FLR2 (4), version u16=2, type u8, flags u8=0, sessionEpoch u32, payloadBytes u32; exactly 16 bytes. Unknown type/version/flags, wrong direction, invalid lengths and trailing bytes reject the whole message.

Strings/variable arrays/bytes use canonical unsigned LEB128 u32 lengths (maximum five bytes, no overlong form). Fixed arrays/bytes omit length. Optional fields use a strict 0/1 byte then value. Strings use strict UTF-8 scalar values, bounded bytes/code points, no C0/C1 controls. Nicknames trim Unicode whitespace then require nonempty; room IDs match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}; hashes are 64 lowercase hex digits.

## Visibility and replication

protocol.yaml sparse fields; optional public dense groups (components 20, 21, 26, 30), identity base fields only; each fields blob is a complete independent type-1 entity block, sequence=1 ack=0, no deletes/events. Public field IDs: 2, 4, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 22, 26, 28, 31, 36, 38, 49, 50, 53, 54, 55, 59, 62. Public dense group components: 20, 21, 26, 30. Private fields appear only in the receiver's selfState: inventory, recharge, backpack, experience, zoneProgress, deathScore, deathLevel, kept, killerName, nextSpawnTick. Entity ownership is public; slot/instance are owner-local. Controlled handle 0 means no body.

Full snapshots replace the entire entity/component state with a new baselineId; deltas require the same room/session/baseline and contiguous snapshotSeq. Event identity is roomEpoch + tick + ordinal, retained across resync and reset on new session binding. Resync never re-executes commands or rewards. Overflow closes the connection; encoded deltas cannot be dropped. Counters must drain before counterDrainAt, with a new room/session epoch before reuse. RoomEpoch and resume tokens require host cryptographic entropy, separate from World RNG. Welcome establishes identity; input/commands carry no player selector. Input receipt and actual simulation adoption are distinct. See [implementation contract](multiplayer/replication.md).
